from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentMatch(BaseModel):
    """Captures one judicial document and the legal causes it matches from the provided list."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title as it appears (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    matched_causes: list[str] | None = Field(description="The specific cause names from the task's provided list that apply to this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentMatch]
